7256.title: Personal child environment eligibility
7256.rootCauseOneLine: Personal-parent placement automatically reuses an unmanaged attached directory that the workspace compatibility validator correctly rejects.
7256.proposedFix: Gate automatic reuse on a ready provider-backed Personal workspace with no teardown; otherwise use existing fresh-workspace placement.
7256.caveats: Server-boundary reproduction, repeated in two clean checkouts; no live desktop/CLI session or retirement timer exercised. Explicit provider reproduction includes its required machine selection. Valid Personal-parent reuse semantics remain unchanged. Reproduction patch and output are inline under the reports repository policy.
